The 1963–64 [[Primeira Liga|Primeira Divisão]] was the 30th season of [[Portuguese football league system|top-tier]] [[Association football|football]] in Portugal.

== Overview ==
It was contested by 14 teams, and [[S.L. Benfica]] won the championship.
